(i) we propose and evaluate AutoPro, an automated fine-grained CPU provisioning system for virtualized environments; and (ii) we show how our system can help both cloud providers and users by optimizing resource utilization and reducing costs.

enabling users of IaaS cloud infrastructures to specify performance SLOs for their applications and to have the cloud automatically provision the necessary amount of resources to meet those SLOs.
enabling users to deploy their applications on IaaS clouds without the need to overprovision resources, while also allowing the provider to maximize node-level resource utilization.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
AutoPro enables users to deploy applications on IaaS clouds with confidence in attaining performance SLOs, without requiring explicit and nontrivial reservations.
AutoPro can help IaaS providers and users alike to reduce costs, improve resource utilization, and meet SLOs.
AutoPro is a runtime system that enables fine-grained CPU allocation based on application-level SLO and best-effort work loads, without the need of explicit reservations.
The main takeaway from our work is that
automated fine-grained provisioning of a shared resource is feasible and can be achieved without requiring offline profiling.
automated fine-grained resource allocation based on SLOs is feasible and beneficial for both users and service providers.

, by automating the provisioning of resources, AutoPro enables users to deploy applications on IaaS clouds with confidence that the performance of the application is not affected by the behavior of other applications colocated on the same host node, while at the same time enabling service providers to maximize the utilization of the infrastructure.
